prompt: [Instruction Sheet] STORYBOARD_PANEL_1_INTRO [Prerequisites] Upload a full-body reference image of the target character. [Purpose] Story introduction scene. Generate a situation where the character from the reference image is trapped as a 2D manga character inside a giant manga book. (Note: In this cut, no live-action 3D person exists outside yet). [Basic Settings and Quality] Quality: Ultra-realistic 8K. Aspect Ratio: 1:1 (fixed square). Background: A beautifully organized bedroom, wooden floor, natural light. [Complete Scene and Composition Specification] Manga book placement: A giant manga book in an open spread, leaning diagonally from background to foreground. Action and situation: No live-action person in front of the book. Focus is on the 'pages inside the book'. Destruction: Paper is not yet torn; the page is in perfect condition. [Manga World Description and Dialogue] Manga specifications: Japanese-style monochrome manga with screentones, thick ink lines, and paneling. Character in manga: Same person as the reference image (2D line drawing). Confused expression, looking around after realizing they are inside the manga. Speech bubble text: 1. 'Where is this...?' 2. 'I can't get out...!' [Absolute Conditions] Depict the space as a 3D room and a 2D manga book without featuring a live-action person. [Instruction Sheet] STORYBOARD_PANEL_2_STRUGGLE [Prerequisites] Upload a full-body reference image. [Purpose] Generate the scene just before a breakout, where the character inside the manga notices the real world and is pushing hard from the inside against the panel borders and paper to tear it. [Basic Settings and Quality] Quality: Ultra-realistic 8K, photorealistic. Aspect Ratio: 1:1. Background: Organized bedroom, wooden floor, natural light. [Complete Scene and Composition Specification] Manga book placement: Giant manga book in an open spread, leaning diagonally. Action and situation: The character in the manga (2D) is pressing both hands strongly against the back of the paper toward the outside world. Destruction/3D expression: The part of the paper being pushed is bulging slightly outward and starting to tear. Depict an omen where only the hands or parts of the body pushing out are beginning to change from monochrome to full color (live-action). [Manga World Description and Dialogue] Manga specifications: Japanese-style monochrome manga. Character in manga: Same person as reference, desperate expression. Speech bubbles: 1. 'The outside world...!?' 2. 'Open up...!' [Absolute Conditions] Depict the tension of the boundary attempting to break the dimensional wall from 2D to 3D. [Instruction Sheet] STORYBOARD_PANEL__V3_PERFECT_BALANCE [Prerequisites] Must upload a full-body reference image. [Purpose] Generate a scene that maintains perfect live-action body proportions while coexisting with the giant manga book structure. [Character Proportion Maintenance (Most Important)] Body type: Perfectly reproduce the character's 'high head-to-body ratio,' 'long legs,' and 'slender stylish skeleton' in both live-action and manga versions. No perspective distortion: Strictly prohibit extreme shortening of legs, lengthening of the torso, or body shape collapse when stepping out. [Basic Settings and Quality] Quality: Ultra-realistic 8K, photorealistic. Aspect Ratio: 1:1. Background: Organized bedroom, wooden floor, natural light. [Complete Scene and Composition Specification] Manga book placement: Giant manga book in an open spread, leaning diagonally. Maintain the structure of book pages rather than just a thick board. Action and pose: The live-action character is stepping out strongly from within the page borders toward the front. One hand placed on the edge of the torn paper. Destruction: Only the part where the person stepped out is torn; the structure of the entire book remains intact. [Manga World Description and Dialogue] Manga specifications: Must be a full Japanese-style monochrome manga layout with multiple panels. Character in manga: Same person as reference (2D line drawing), standing in confusion. Speech bubbles: 1. 'Huh...?' 2. 'Me... why am I in a place like this...!?' 3. 'Is this... inside a manga...?' 4. 'How do I get out...?' [Absolute Conditions] Maintain the structure of the open book and panel divisions while keeping proportions correct. Depict strong contrast between full-color live-action and monochrome 2D manga. [Instruction Sheet] MANGA_BREAKOUT_FINALE_PUNCHLINE [Prerequisites] Upload a full-body reference image. [Purpose] Generate a humorous 'punchline' scene where the live-action person who escaped meets the manga version, and they point at each other in surprise. [Basic Settings and Quality] Quality: Ultra-realistic 8K, photorealistic. Aspect Ratio: 1:1. [Complete Scene and Composition Specification] Manga book placement: Giant manga book in an open spread, leaning diagonally. Action and pose: The live-action person has completely escaped, turned around, and is facing the manga page. The live-action and manga versions are looking at each other with wide eyes, pointing at each other. Destruction: Part of the page remains torn. [Manga World Description and Dialogue] Manga specifications: Japanese-style monochrome manga. Character in manga: Same person as reference (2D), shocked at seeing the live-action version. Speech bubbles: 1. 'Ehh!?' 2. 'No way... you really came out!?' 3. 'Who... are you!?' [Absolute Conditions] Do not collapse live-action body proportions. Clarify the contrast between full-color live-action and monochrome 2D manga. [Instruction Sheet] 4-IMAGE_STORYBOARD_2X2_LAYOUT_COMPACT [Placement] Organize the 4 uploaded reference images into one 4-panel storyboard. 2x2 configuration: 1st=top-left, 2nd=top-right, 3rd=bottom-left, 4th=bottom-right. [Image Handling] Do not change aspect ratios. No stretching or warping. Fit the entire image into the panel and fill gaps with white. [Background/Margins] White background. 16px white margin between panels. No decorative frames. [Maintenance Conditions] Do not change the person, face, pose, background, color, or quality. Do not add or delete elements. Maintain existing text within the original images. [Most Important Condition] Do not change reference image ratios. Arrange in order: top-left -> top-right -> bottom-left -> bottom-right. Do not redraw reference images.

promptZh: [指令表] STORYBOARD_PANEL_1_INTRO [前提条件] 上传目标角色的全身参考图。[目的] 故事开场场景。生成一个场景，参考图中的角色作为 2D 漫画人物被困在一本巨大的漫画书中。（注意：在此镜头中，书外尚无真人）。[基本设置与质量] 质量：超写实 8K。长宽比：1:1（固定正方形）。背景：布置整洁的卧室，木地板，自然光。[完整场景与构图规范] 漫画书摆放：一本巨大的漫画书呈打开状态，从背景向前景斜向放置。动作与情境：书前没有真人。焦点在于“书页内部”。破坏效果：纸张尚未撕裂；页面保持完好。[漫画世界描述与对话] 漫画规格：日式黑白漫画，带有网点、粗线条和分镜格。漫画中的角色：与参考图为同一人（2D 线稿）。表情困惑，意识到自己身处漫画中，正在四处张望。气泡文字：1. “这是哪里……？” 2. “我出不去……！” [绝对条件] 将空间描绘为 3D 房间和 2D 漫画书，不得出现真人。
